title: Triage threshold discrepancy: baby above bilirubin cutoff showed normal care
content: In our facility, a 38-week infant at 48 hours with severe jaundice showed 'No further action from this screen' instead of referral. The triage rule threshold should have recommended a blood test.

title: Unencrypted participant token found in diagnostic log export
content: A diagnostic export file contained an unencrypted auth secret and enrollment token in plaintext. Potential privacy and security incident per doc 8 Section 12.

title: App crashes on language selection screen S01 when rotated
content: FATAL EXCEPTION: java.lang.NullPointerException at com.kitalonlabs.neogold.feature.onboarding.LanguageScreenKt.LanguageScreen. The app closes when rotating the device.

title: Unclear lighting warning when capturing card photo
content: How far should I hold the phone from the baby's chest? The app kept showing lighting warning even though the room lights were turned on.
